more_info.overview: Butane-1,3-diol is a four-carbon alcohol with hydroxyl groups at the first and third carbon positions. The chemical record also calls it 1,3-butanediol or butylene glycol. It is a defined small molecule, unlike polymeric glycols or ester mixtures with similar names. The reviewed identity source does not establish a typical human-food application or a food-additive intake limit for this legacy entry.
